description: This is the main entry point for a React application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the root App component. It initializes the React root and renders the App component within React.StrictMode into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node.
